metadata.case_name: IP WAN FUNG v. CHEUNG WING HONG T/A BILLION RESTAURANT CO

plaintiff.occupation_before: food product salesman (employed by Tsit Wing Coffee Company Limited)

source: The clinical diagnosis was back contusion.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

source: he hit his head against the glass door of the Restaurant and then fell to the ground and landed on his back.
he sustained personal injuries at the back and the head ("the Accident").

manifestations.description: local tenderness over his low back
persistent back pain which exacerbated on walking and prolonged standing
intermittent and daily attacks of low back pain that last for 2-3 minutes
pain after walking for 15 minutes while holding samples of food products or bending down to lift heavy objects
decrease in back range of movement for extension
mild muscle waste at right calf
Straight Leg Raising (SLR) range was 70° on the right and 60° on the left side with pain
myotone of the L2 and S1 was grade 4, myotone of L3 to L4 was grade 4+ and myotone of L5 and S2 was grade 5-

treatments_received: admitted overnight at Queen Elizabeth Hospital for observation
physiotherapy (initial assessment and 5 sessions; defaulted after 5 sessions)
out-patient treatments at government clinics (Department of Family Medicine & General Outpatient Clinic at Fanling)
consultations with orthopaedic and traumatology specialists in private practice (Dr. Poon Kai Ming, Dr. Chang Shao, Dr. Yong Kong Fan and Dr. Hung Siu Lun)

losses.description: persistent back pain which exacerbated on walking and prolonged standing; pain after walking for 15 minutes while holding samples of food products

reduction in work efficiency on prolonged walking especially while carrying heavy food product samples; difficulty in getting further employment and disadvantage in the labour market as a food products salesman
